entities.summary: Dominique Bulamatari was a Congolese Roman Catholic prelate. Bulamatari served as the auxiliary bishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Kinshasa from 1999 until 2009. In 2009, he was appointed Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Molegbe, based in the northern city of Molegbe, where he served until his resignation and retirement on 1 August 2023.
